name: dl-round0-before
cmd: GDP_TD_ROUND0=research/protocols/engine/picks/distributed_lock.txt timeout -s KILL 280 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 240000 --only distributed_lock --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/e.log >/dev/null; grep ROUND0 /tmp/e.log | cut -c1-200

name: dl-round0-strict
cmd: GDP_MBQI_STRICT=1 GDP_TD_ROUND0=research/protocols/engine/picks/distributed_lock.txt timeout -s KILL 280 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 240000 --only distributed_lock --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/e.log >/dev/null; grep ROUND0 /tmp/e.log | cut -c1-200
